LiteLLM Credential Harvester via PyPI (TeamPCP)

Target: litellm
Repository: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm
Date: 2026-03-24
Attribution: Advanced Persistent Threat
Component: Library
Language: Python
Cause: Compromised Account/Credentials
Motive: Credential Theft/Lateral Movement
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Credential Theft/System Compromise
User Impact: 0
Domain: pypi.org (package host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

TeamPCP used PyPI publishing tokens harvested from the Trivy breach to compromise the package. A malicious litellm_init.pth file auto-executed on Python process startup, injecting code into proxy_server.py to harvest environment variables, SSH keys, cloud credentials, and Kubernetes tokens, attempting to deploy privileged pods and establish persistence via systemd.

Compromised Versions

  • 1.82.7
  • 1.82.8
